meta.notes: A fluid. One element makes the fluid, its liquid block (the same id, msm_examples:oil) and its bucket (msm_examples:oil_bucket). "behaves_like" water joins the water tag, so you swim in it and drown in it; "flow" makes it slow (one block every 20 ticks), short (it finds slopes two blocks away and loses two levels a block) and finite (no new sources). "on_entity_inside" names an event in the fluid's own "events": whoever is inside gets Slowness II, at most every ten ticks each. "textures" are the still and flowing pictures and the bucket's; "tint" is left out because the pictures are already dark. It needs the Fabric mod jar export; the vanilla packs keep only its trades, tags, pictures and language keys.
